head: 1cce9cec
note: Written BY HAND beside the REVIEW file. `planning.mjs adjudication` refuses --phase 0 with no-phase-dir: it writes beside a sibling REVIEW under phases/<N>/ or deferred/<N>/, and a task deliberately has neither - workflows/task.md uses phase 0 precisely so a task record never joins a phase.

entries.claim: Every failure to read an existing decline file is treated as an empty file, so a successful write erases all prior declines.
entries.failure_scenario: A mode-000 DECLINED.md under a writable .planning reads EACCES, the catch sets text empty, atomicWrite replaces the file, and every older fingerprint is dropped.

entries.claim: mirrorFiled does not detect the appender rejecting a row, so it reports a decline recorded after writing nothing.
entries.failure_scenario: A forge slug containing whitespace makes appendDeclinedRow return the text unchanged; atomicWrite succeeds and the batch reports ok while the fingerprint is absent.

entries.claim: The ENOENT arm cannot distinguish an absent DECLINED.md from a dangling symlink, against the function own stated policy.
entries.failure_scenario: A symlink whose target is missing reads ENOENT and returns an empty set, so every decline in the unreachable target resurfaces.

entries.claim: A malformed or conflicted record is accepted as a complete lookup because parse failures reduce to a partial fingerprint set.
entries.failure_scenario: A merge conflict damages a row, parseDeclinedRows skips it, readDeclines still returns ok:true, and the gate re-asks the omitted settled finding.

entries.claim: Declines are marked filed only in memory and are not persisted before later accepted findings perform fallible creates.
entries.failure_scenario: A decline ahead of a failing accept is reported among the filed prefix with no row written, so the next unfixed asks it again.

counter_evidence.note: The create-failure branch calls mirrorFiled(dir, forge.provider, forge.repo, filed) BEFORE emitting the refusal, and `filed` holds every decline pushed ahead of the failure. The comment above that call states the reason it runs there. A regression test now fires a create failure after a decline and asserts the row is on disk.
